title: No‑Bake Cookie with Marshmallow and Rice Cereal

content.title: About
content.content: This soft, no‑bake cookie is made from rolled oats, rice cereal, butter, sugar, marshmallows and a hint of vanilla. The mixture is shaped into small rounds and chilled until firm.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: No‑bake desserts retain more vitamins and minerals because they are not exposed to high heat.
Marshmallows add sweetness and a melt‑in‑your‑mouth texture, while rice cereal contributes a light crunch.
These treats are popular in the United States during summer when people prefer not to heat the oven.
The combination of oats and rice provides both complex carbs and quick‑release energy.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Oats and rice cereal are rich in fiber, which supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Contains healthy fats
items.content: Butter (or optional nuts) supplies monounsaturated fats that are heart‑friendly.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Sugar and marshmallows raise blood glucose rapidly, making the cookie a convenient pre‑workout snack.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Oats provide thiamine, niacin and folate, which aid metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Rice cereal and butter contribute magnesium, phosphorus and iron.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: The large amount of sugar and marshmallows can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of cavities.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Butter makes the product unsuitable for those with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Gluten sensitivity
items.content: Rolled oats may contain gluten; gluten‑free oats should be used for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Choking hazard for children
items.content: Marshmallows and larger pieces can pose a choking risk for young kids.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the cookie as a standalone snack, crumble it over yogurt or ice cream, or use it as a base for dessert parfaits. Keep it chilled to maintain its shape.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 7 days. For longer keeping, freeze in a freezer‑safe bag, noting that texture may change slightly.
